taglines: It is Tuesday which is Monday's less dramatic cousin who still shows up exactly as inconvenient but without the theatrical entrance and you cannot even be properly annoyed about it because Tuesday did not ask for this role and is simply occupying it with a kind of bland dependability that is somehow worse.

You have nine browser tabs open and three of them are doing something important and six of them are doing something that felt important when you opened them and you are not going to close any of them because closing them would require deciding something and you are saving your decisions for later.

Summer is happening right now outside the window and you are aware of this in the way you are aware of most things which is abstractly and from a distance and with a low-grade intention to engage with it more directly at some point which is a sentence you have been saying since June 1st.

Your to-do list has seventeen items and two of them are from last week and one of them is from a week before that and the oldest one has been on there so long it has become less of a task and more of a philosophical question about what you actually value and you are not ready to answer that today.

Someone in your life is doing great. You saw it on the internet. They are thriving and pivoting and launching things and posting about it in a way that is humble but somehow also not humble and you are genuinely happy for them in the way that sits right next to a feeling you are not going to name.

The day has not started badly. You are noting this specifically because it is unusual enough to note and also because noting it feels like tempting something and you are noting it anyway because you are trying to be a person who appreciates the small good stretches instead of simply waiting for them to end.

June 23rd. The year is more than half over. You had a list of things you were going to do by now and the list is somewhere and the somewhere is doing fine and the things are in various states of almost and soon and technically still possible and the year is being very patient with you about all of it.

At some point today you will do something competent and it will go unnoticed except by you and you will notice it and then immediately forget you noticed it and this is mostly fine but somewhere in the accounting of your life it is a line item and the line item matters and you matter and it is Tuesday and you showed up.
